DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap).

I have reviewed the history of the 3-month-old boy; while the father's history of psoriasis is noted, the onset at this age, the scaly nature of the rash, and the tendency to worsen in cold weather are classic for seborrheic dermatitis.
